youtube_title: Eye Twitching For Days? It's Usually This | Body Fix #22 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #22. Eye twitching for 3 days, and Nani says something's going to HAPPEN.
Mostly B. Stress, low sleep, too much caffeine. A tired muscle, usually HARMLESS.
Short sleep, 4 chais a day, hours of screen: the eyelid muscle starts twitching.
Fix: Full sleep, less caffeine, screen breaks, warm or cool compress.
Red flags: Lasts weeks, eyelid closes fully, or face twitches too? See a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: Cleveland Clinic - eyelid twitching
